quests.name: advanc.welcome
quests.label: Advanced Lighting
quests.text: Lights: a hanging lantern, a wall sconce and a floor lamp in every metal, gem lamps, cloth lanterns, candles, braziers, floodlights, a street lamp, a beacon - and glimmercaps and glimmer moss in the caves of new worlds.
